Name: Validate Username field is visible when Login page loads
Description: Verify that the Username input field is displayed on the Login page when it initially loads.
Steps: 1. Navigate to Login page.
Expected Result:
1. Username field is visible on the page.
2. Username label should be "Username".
3. Username input field should be visible with no default value.

Name: Validate Password field is visible when Login page loads
Description: Verify that the Password input field is displayed on the Login page when it initially loads.
Steps: 1. Navigate to Login page.
Expected Result:
1. Password field is visible on the page.
2. Password label should be "Password".
3. Password input field should be visible with no default value.

Name: Validate Login button is visible when Login page loads
Description: Verify that the Login button is displayed on the Login page when it initially loads.
Steps: 1. Navigate to Login page.
Expected Result:
1. Login button is visible on the page.
2. Login button text should be "Login".

Name: Validate Remember Me checkbox is visible when Login page loads
Description: Verify that the Remember Me checkbox is displayed on the Login page when it initially loads.
Steps: 1. Navigate to Login page.
Expected Result:
1. Remember Me checkbox is visible on the page.
2. Remember Me label should be "Remember Me".

Name: Validate Login button is disabled when page loads
Description: Verify that the Login button is in disabled state when the Login page loads, as both fields are initially empty.
Steps: 1. Navigate to Login page.
Expected Result: 1. Login button is disabled.

Name: Validate Remember Me checkbox is unchecked when page loads
Description: Verify that the Remember Me checkbox is in unchecked state by default when the Login page loads.
Steps: 1. Navigate to Login page.
Expected Result: 1. Remember Me checkbox is unchecked.

Name: Validate Username field is empty when page loads
Description: Verify that the Username field is empty when the Login page loads.
Steps: 1. Navigate to Login page.
Expected Result: 1. Username field is empty.

Name: Validate Password field is empty when page loads
Description: Verify that the Password field is empty when the Login page loads.
Steps: 1. Navigate to Login page.
Expected Result: 1. Password field is empty.

Name: Validate Login button is enabled when both fields contain valid data
Description: Verify that the Login button becomes enabled when both Username and Password fields contain valid data.
Steps:
1. Enter a valid email address in Username field.
2. Enter a valid password in Password field.
Expected Result:
1. Username field accepts the input.
2. Login button becomes enabled.

Name: Validate Login button remains disabled when only Username is valid
Description: Verify that the Login button remains disabled when only Username field contains valid data but Password is empty.
Steps: 1. Enter a valid email address in Username field.
Expected Result:
1. Username field accepts the input.
2. Login button remains disabled.

Name: Validate Login button remains disabled when only Password is valid
Description: Verify that the Login button remains disabled when only Password field contains valid data but Username is empty.
Steps: 1. Enter a valid password in Password field.
Expected Result:
1. Password field accepts the input.
2. Login button remains disabled.

Name: Validate Login button is disabled when Username is invalid
Description: Verify that the Login button remains disabled when Username field contains invalid data even if Password is valid.
Steps:
1. Enter an invalid email address in Username field.
2. Enter a valid password in Password field.
Expected Result:
1. Username field accepts the input.
2. Login button remains disabled.

Name: Validate Login button is disabled when Password is invalid
Description: Verify that the Login button remains disabled when Password field contains invalid data even if Username is valid.
Steps:
1. Enter a valid email address in Username field.
2. Enter an invalid password in Password field.
Expected Result:
1. Both fields accept the input.
2. Login button remains disabled.

Name: Validate Remember Me checkbox can be checked
Description: Verify that the Remember Me checkbox can be checked by the user.
Steps: 1. Click on Remember Me checkbox.
Expected Result: 1. Remember Me checkbox becomes checked.

Name: Validate Remember Me checkbox can be unchecked
Description: Verify that the Remember Me checkbox can be unchecked after being checked.
Steps: 1. Click on Remember Me checkbox.
Expected Result: 1. Remember Me checkbox becomes unchecked.

Name: Validate Username accepts 100 characters
Description: Verify that Username field accepts the maximum allowed length of 100 characters.
Steps: 1. Enter a valid email address with exactly 100 characters in Username field.
Expected Result: 1. Username field accepts the 100-character input.

Description: Verify that Username field rejects input exceeding the maximum allowed length of 100 characters.
Steps: 1. Enter a valid email address with 101 characters in Username field.
Expected Result: 1. Username field does not accept the 101st character or displays a validation error.

Expected Result: 1. Password field accepts the 8-character input.

Description: Verify that Password field rejects input below the minimum allowed length of 8 characters.

Expected Result: 1. Password field displays a validation error indicating minimum length requirement.
